messages:
Jordan: Quick idea — run an A/B on the pricing page: freemium vs trial-first. Wanted to sketch the funnel + calculator change. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya: Love it. What's the primary hypothesis we want to validate?
Jordan: Hypothesis: freemium lowers sign-up friction and boosts developer adoption; trial-first drives higher paid conversion. We should measure: sign-ups, activation, MQL rate, and CAC.
Mateo: For the calculator, idea to show a simple estimated monthly bill so folks see value immediately. Proposed formula snippet to keep devs honest:
```
Inputs:
  requests_per_day = R
  avg_tokens_per_request = T
  avg_days_per_month = 30
Monthly_tokens = R * T * 30
Monthly_cost = (Monthly_tokens / 1000) * rate_per_k_tokens
```
Keep it minimal and explain assumptions.
Riley: Copy note: considering renaming tiers to 'Dev / Team / Enterprise' — feels clearer for a PLG motion. Alternative: 'Starter / Scale / Enterprise' if we want org-speak. Which do we prefer? :memo: 
Priya: Quick user test — ping 15 devs in the onboarding cohort with a 2-option micro survey on tier labels. Also A/B headline: "Start for free" vs "Start a 14-day trial".
Jordan: Routing play: if someone uses the calc and picks Enterprise settings, auto-tag as sales-qualified and trigger the enterprise nurture + calendar CTA. @Mateo can you surface that tag to HubSpot?
Mateo: Yep. I'll add a query param mapping: `?pricing_variant=freemium|trial&calc_tier=dev|team|enterprise` -> map to hs_lead_source and hs_tier. Will also emit an event for product analytics.
Riley: FAQ updates: propose adding three short Qs: cost drivers, burst/throughput limits, trial/data retention. I'll draft microcopy (one-liners).
Marketing Bot: Deployed two staging variants: `/pricing?variant=freemium` and `/pricing?variant=trial` — both include the experimental calculator behind `?show_calc=1`. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Performance note — lazy-load the calculator iframe and server-render the headline to avoid CLS. Also ensure GA events fire even if JS blocked.
Jordan: Timeline: ship experiment to staging by EOD Tuesday, QA Wed morning, flip pilot to 10% traffic Wed afternoon, run 3 weeks. Owners: Jordan (experiment), Priya (measurement), Mateo (routing/telemetry), Riley (copy).
Priya: No blockers from me. Scheduling a 30m sync for tomorrow to align metrics & GTM. :calendar:
Jordan: Awesome — thanks all. I'll drop the experiment doc in the marketing drive and link in here. :rocket:
